sentences.text: Heard.
Issue notice.
Learned counsel for the respondent no. 1accepted notice and vehemently opposed the instant appeal.
He prayed for four weeks' time to file reply.
Let the same be filed within four weeks as prayed.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within two weeks thereafter.
Issue notice to the respondent nos. 2 & 4 through all permissible modes on filing PF within a week.
List on 17th September, 2024 before Joint Registrar (Judicial) for completion of service and pleadings.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J JULY 15, 2024 rk/ryp
